import numpy as np
from mpi4py import MPI

comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD.Dup()

result = np.zeros_like(source)
comm.Allreduce(source, result)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result, comm.size * (comm.size + 1) / 2)
comm.Free()
if MPI.COMM_WORLD.rank == 0:
    print("PASS: host-only MPI collective without WarpX")
